comments.text:
Post-conversion enhancements + brief realignment, all shipped to main and verified live.

Guides (13):
- Shared top nav via guides/toc.js — Back / Home / Next, sticky, single-sourced page order; works in portrait (replaced an earlier side-rail that broke narrow).
- Per-topic eyebrow labels (was the generic "a guide for everyone").
- Open Graph + Twitter Card meta on all 13 (shared hook image) so a shared guide link renders a preview card; og:image verified 200.

AGENTS.md (was stale vs the converted architecture):
- Killed dead URLs (walkthrough_html/<beat>.html and beat_scripts.md — 404 after the beats were retired).
- Reframed Mode B from CCD-only beats to a universal capability ladder: drive the page live / offer the link (with preview card) / explain in own words.
- De-salesed agent-facing vocabulary (pitch, manifesto, killer feature, CTA -> explain, framing, standout, ask) so the brief models inform-don't-convert.
- Rebuilt the skills section as an HTTPS-fetchable index: each skill described + its raw SKILL.md URL, readable by any agent WITHOUT cloning.
- Removed the "court-defensible" overclaim; added an explicit no-legal/security-overclaim tone rule.

5 walkthrough skills:
- Added the same delivery ladder ("## How to show it").
- Repointed image refs from a bare relative walkthrough_html/images/ path to absolute Pages URLs (no clone needed).

Validation: PRINCIPAL ran AGENTS.md through a non-Claude model — it behaved as designed (advisory not sales, honest about non-fit, absorbed the no-overclaim discipline, translated to context). That run also surfaced the de-sales + no-clone improvements above, which are now shipped.

Commits on main: 1e2f1cf (conversion publish + nav + eyebrows), 4a6e48f (AGENTS.md rewrite + OG cards), e8d6b49 (de-sales + no-clone index + delivery ladder). CLAUDE.md kept local/untracked by design.

title: Post-ship polish + AGENTS.md realignment (nav, eyebrows, OG cards, de-sales, no-clone skills index, delivery ladder)
